title: Stellaria
description: A mod dedicated to fighting enemies in a space-like environment!
body:
![Stellaria logo text](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9a5d0749b24da2836c1cd712ef3bf532ecdb8415.png)
------------------------------------------

  Stellaria is a mod about fighting dragon like creatures in a space-like environment and their respective minions. This mod is experimenting with a completely new way of fighting in Minecraft so any balancing suggestions are welcome.


#   How to play the mod

This mod was made for a **late game** experience so it is recommended that before crafting the portal to the fighting dimension, to have fully **enchanted diamond/netherite** armor with **potions/golden apples**

## Recipe for portal
![Draconic crystal block (Portal)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a828ad00f439008f110be432a0e56eb7d669f918.png)

## Things to know

- This dimension has auto keepinventory since losing items in a space-like dimension is pretty annoying 
- Once inside, the only way out is either death or victory 
- **REALLY IMPORTANT!** For this mod to work as intended, please make sure every time you are inside the dimension to have your render and simulation set to a minimum of 30 chunks and Entity distance to 500%
- While in the boss fight, the game will render some special clouds with a custom shader that might lag your computer, for this I added a custom config so that you can decrease/increase the quality

## Content to be added

  This mod for now has only one boss named Zregos and its minions: Crystalius, Cosmic Spider and Zregos Servant but as the mod lives I will try my best to add the remaining bosses : █████████, ███████ and ███-█████, each with 3 minions to protect them and more weapons
